text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and can not vouch for their accuracy.
- Thirty seven deputy ministers and two high commissioners appointed by president Frederick Chiluba this week, were sworn-in on Wednesday.
- The government will from now on screen asylum seekers to curb an influx of bandits and poachers, home affairs minister Chitalu Sampa said.
- President Chiluba said the agricultural sector should be the mainstream of the economy and warned that he would not condone inefficiency at the relevant ministries.
- Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) copper output dropped in the quarter ended September 30, from the corresponding 1995 quarter, a company spokesman said.
